decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line builds directly on the firm's long-standing cosmetic formulation knowledge, and it kept its own dedicated page in both years, which shows it is a core line whose market feedback the firm can readily interpret and use.

A hyaluronic acid serum draws on well-understood active ingredients the firm can formulate and refine with its existing know-how, and it stayed on the website across both years, though with only a mention rather than strong prominence.

The cleansing oil appears to replace the dropped cleansing milk, so it applies what the firm learned from that product within the same cleansing segment, which justifies giving it more time despite limited early visibility.
